title: Corn Gnocchi in Brown Butter
subtitle: with charred corn and lime
description: Gnocchi made from baked potato and fresh blitzed corn, tossed in clarified butter with fresh corn kernels, sage and za'atar leaves.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Scatter a layer of coarse salt on the paper, place the potatoes on top and bake for about 30 minutes until soft.

While the potatoes bake, shave the kernels from 3 corn cobs with a knife. Heat a pan with olive oil and saute the kernels for 5 minutes over high heat. Remove from the heat, wait 5 minutes and blend the kernels to a smooth mash in a food processor.
Take the potatoes out of the oven, let them cool for about 5 minutes, halve and scoop the flesh into a bowl with a spoon. Mash to a smooth puree, preferably with a potato masher.
Add the blitzed corn, flour, egg yolk and salt to the potato and mix and knead to a soft, smooth dough (avoid over-kneading). Divide the dough into 5 equal parts.
Roll each part into a long thin rope on a floured surface. Cut each rope into 2 to 3 cm pieces and transfer to a floured tray. This is the stage to freeze them if you like.

Bring plenty of water to the boil in a tall pot and add a teaspoon of salt. Cook the gnocchi in several batches (not too many at once, so they do not stick) for 2 minutes or until they float. Remove with a slotted spoon to a colander.

Shave the kernels from the remaining 2 corn cobs. Heat the ghee in a wide, deep pan, add the corn kernels, za'atar leaves and sage leaves, then add the gnocchi and shake the pan so they are all coated in the butter. Add pepper and sea salt and serve.
